title: Proclamation S.I. 1984, No. 180 of November 20, 1984 of the Industrial Designs Act, 1981 (Act 1981-57)
text:
S.I. 1984 No. 180
1B
By His Excellency Sir Hugh Worrell Springer, Knight Grand Cross of the Most Distinguished
Order of Saint Michael and Saint George, Knight of Saint Andrew, Commander of the Most
Excellent Order of the British Empire, Governor-General of Barbados.
HUGH W. SPRINGER
Governor-General.
A PROCLAMATION
0B
WHEREAS by section 51 of the Industrial Designs Act, 1981 (Act 1981 - 57) it is provided
HU UH
that the said Act shall come into operation on a day to be fixed by proclamation:
AND WHEREAS it is expedient that the said Act shall come into operation on the 1st day of
January, 1985:
NOW THEREFORE by virtue of the authority in me vested, I do hereby fix the 1st day of
January, 1985 as the day on which the said Act shall come into operation.
Given under my hand and the Public Seal of Barbados this 20th day of November, 1984 and
in the Thirty-third year of Her Majesty’s Reign.
